scope: Exploratory conditional counterfactuals in the exact historical hidden world, with fresh future chance and search seeds. Does not establish population strength or information-set optimality.
engine: Downloaded production WASM, same bindings as original production worker
conserveHeal: After normal 81k blind search, when its selected action is Soft-Boiled, own HP >60%, own status is not frozen, opposing active is a non-frozen Blissey and Ice Beam is legal, use Ice Beam. Re-evaluate each turn; all other actions follow the deployed bot.
pairing: Same initial future chance seed and both search seeds per pair; random consumption can diverge after different actions.
limits: 2200 decision points. Incomplete games are missing, not draws. No early stopping on favorable outcomes.
rationale: Original production trace repeatedly heals Blissey at 76-93% HP in a mirror; test whether preserving heal PP and attempting freeze sooner helps. Selected from behavior before continuation outcomes.
history: Replay every historical observation, including the final pre-root log. Then observe the reseeded log-empty fork to reset its log cursor. One extra unused root search seed is consumed in BOTH arms; all trial seeds are fresh.
